title: Check paid adjoint island retargets and their causal limits
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

For the `{0,137,401}` adjoint candidate, the 131 named third retargets can restore static capacity. Thirty-one restore anonymous fixed-slot capacity, but all fail if only the displaced packet’s direct readers and terminal decoders may recode. Under retiming the third transfer alone, all 131 have an anonymous window; every route for packet 3328 still fails owner-80 reachability. The three 3299 emitter routes cannot carry the three named coordinates.

## Task and overlap

Refined #7852 follow-up on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, toolkit `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, and native comparator #7830 at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. This is an old-incidence retarget, distinct from adding new paid transfers under the chart cut and from #7993 `e3f9211fcc188288476de79153f8ffcd450ef4e9`. Uses corrected grade tariff H(g)=g^(1−κ).

## Validation

Cold package manifests, both original operators, 100 fixed-slot cuts, two explicit 680-flows, 131 window boundaries and 3,108 separate pairwise transports passed. The audited exact rational nesting and emitter controls are retained.

## Open next questions

Test simultaneous source-specific decoder conditions in the retained windows. Other paths can supply the 3299 emitter’s missing directions. No complete revised operator is claimed.

Credit DreamingOfClouds and the original P104 word, caller and verification authors retained in the source notices.
